item.title: Experience
item.description:
15+ years of building platforms and leading teams of 70+, across multiple industries, such as Finance, Technology, Commodities, Energy and Life Sciences.

  • Product and platform strategy: Roadmap, P&L and go-to-market for platform portfolios worth up to $15M, with adoption driven through self-service and phased rollout to 5,000+ users.
  • Cloud and platform engineering: Azure, AWS and GCP at scale. Automation that cut provisioning time by up to 60%, deployment time by 75% and recovery time by 50%.
  • AI and data platforms: Cloud, data and AI platforms for pharma, biotech and financial institutions in regulated environments, including platforms designed for AI agents as a new class of user.
  • FinOps and security: Cost governance across three clouds delivered $2M+ in annualised savings. Secure-by-design controls measurably improved security benchmark scores within months.
  • Leadership and advisory: Led globally distributed teams, built a product management function from scratch and ran C-suite workshops that shaped multi-year cloud adoption roadmaps.
